title: Mercedes A-Class Production line
summary: Footage of the Mercedes A-Class production line at the Rastatt plant in Germany, filmed in 2013. It shows robots and fixtures working through assembly.
why: Used as a concrete example of modern car assembly, with short cycle times and heavy robotic automation, in manufacturing and automation threads.

quote.text: Here's the Mercedes A-class assembly line.[1] Cycle time is about 40 seconds.
